title: Philosophy
use_cases: Configure when seeking to maintain consistent authorial style via Voice DNA
Implement when drafting long-form content to prevent context bloat across sections
Use when building domain-specific templates requiring custom nomenclature like surahs or acts
Configure when integrating with automated publishing workflows for KDP packaging
Use when automating manuscript generation through the Claude Code terminal interface
content:
Scriven is built on five principles:

1. **The writer's voice is sacred.** The drafter never imposes generic AI style. Every drafted sentence passes through the Voice DNA gate.

1. **Fresh context per atomic unit.** Each scene, subsection, or passage is drafted in a clean context. This prevents voice drift, context bloat, and keeps each unit at its best.

1. **Progressive disclosure.** Onboarding asks 3 questions, not 30. Depth is optional and always additive.

1. **Tradition-native vocabulary.** A Quran commentary uses surahs and ayahs. A Bible study uses books and verses. A screenplay uses acts and scenes. The tool adapts to the tradition -- the writer never adapts to the tool.

1. **`/scr-next` always works in Claude Code.** The universal interface. A writer who only ever types `/scr-next` can complete an entire novel, from blank page to KDP package.
